params.name: status
params.description: System status of the campaign. Values: "active", "balance_issue", "budget_exhausted", "inactive", "disabled", "archived".

params.name: enabled
params.description: User status of the campaign. Values: "active", "inactive".

params.name: date_from
params.description: Start date for the statistics in Y-m-d format. Defaults to first of the current month.

params.name: date_to
params.description: End date for the statistics in Y-m-d format. Defaults to today.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records to return. Max 1000. Default 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset for the records to return.

params.name: aggregate
params.description: If 'yes', statistics aggregated by date are retrieved.
